critique: The black background and warm gold glow are appropriate, but both frames contain only one or two tiny central glowing dots. At t4 the dot merely splits/drifts slightly downward; there is no broad horizontal elliptical particle field, disc edge, or distributed magical energy. This is far from the Magic Disc thumbnail silhouette and scale.

suggestions.why: Switch the emitter from its apparent Point mode to Grid so the existing grid count and emitter dimensions can produce a disc plane rather than coincident central particles.
The current 20000-pixel grid width places nearly all grid samples far outside the frame, leaving only the center visible. A roughly frame-width extent should create a broad horizontal disc.
Compress the grid vertically so its on-screen distribution reads as a shallow horizontal ellipse rather than a tall field.
Increase simultaneous particle density so the grid resolves into a luminous, continuous magic-disc surface even in the very early sampled frames.
